links.comparator_used: Public baseline pulmonary TB classifier used without local adaptation
links.outcome: Held-out ROC AUC (paired difference between adapted model and public baseline)
links.effect: Adapted model ROC AUC 0.9902 (95 % CI 0.9694-1.0000), F1 0.9375, PR AUC 0.9557 on held-out n=76 (15 TB-positive); paired AUC difference from public baseline 0.0054 (95 % CI -0.0077 to 0.0230; p = 0.4864)
links.quote: The paired AUC difference from the public baseline was 0.0054 (95 % CI -0.0077 to 0.0230; p = 0.4864), showing no statistical superiority.

design_hint: local adaptation (fine-tuning) before deployment compared with public baseline
